

// package main




fn main( ) -> (()) {
    
        

let rt = tokio::runtime::Builder::new_current_thread().build().unwrap();




rt.block_on(async {





tokio::select! {
biased;

    


_ = async {
    ()
}
 => {

    

print!("only default");




},



}






tokio::select! {
biased;

    


_ = async {
    ()
}
 => {

},



}








{ ::core::future::pending::<()>().await } 






print!("after pending selection");




});



    
}
